title: Isara, which aims to build software that can coordinate the work of thousands of AI agents, raised $94M and says OpenAI backed the startup at a $650M valuation (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Berber Jin / Wall Street Journal: Isara, which aims to build software that can coordinate the work of thousands of AI agents, raised $94M and says OpenAI backed the startup at a $650M valuation — Isara, founded by a pair of 23-year-old researchers, aims to build software that can coordinate the work of thousands of ‘agents’
